jsonc-key-comments.file: Path relative to this config file unless absolute.
jsonc-key-comments.layer: Mechanical layer id; see valid ids in the header.
jsonc-key-comments.kind: Mechanical layer kind enum name; see valid kind names in the header.

jsonc-comments.file: PcbDoc file to create, relative to this config file unless absolute.
jsonc-comments.board_outline_mils.left: Left board outline coordinate in mils.
jsonc-comments.board_outline_mils.bottom: Bottom board outline coordinate in mils.
jsonc-comments.board_outline_mils.right: Right board outline coordinate in mils.
jsonc-comments.board_outline_mils.top: Top board outline coordinate in mils.
jsonc-comments.layer_stack: Generated rigid stack. Use stackupx_file instead for imported .stackupx layer-stack documents.
jsonc-comments.stackupx_file: Optional .stackupx path to import as the PcbDoc layer-stack document.
jsonc-comments.layer_stack.name: Layer-stack display name.
jsonc-comments.layer_stack.copper_layers.name: Copper layer display name.
jsonc-comments.layer_stack.dielectrics_between: Dielectric layers between adjacent copper layers.
jsonc-comments.layer_stack.dielectrics_between.name: Dielectric layer display name.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_profile: Optional shorthand. Options: none, standard_component_pairs, v7_mechanical_53. Explicit mechanical rows override this profile.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layers: Editable single or unpaired mechanical layer rows.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layers.layer: Mechanical layer id; see valid ids in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layers.name: Mechanical layer display name.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layers.enabled: Whether the mechanical layer is enabled.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layers.kind: Optional mechanical layer kind enum name; see valid kind names in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs: Editable grouped top/bottom mechanical layer pair rows.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.top.layer: Top-side mechanical layer id; see valid ids in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.top.name: Top-side mechanical layer display name.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.top.enabled: Whether the top-side layer is enabled.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.top.kind: Top-side mechanical layer kind enum name; see valid kind names in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.bottom.layer: Bottom-side mechanical layer id; see valid ids in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.bottom.name: Bottom-side mechanical layer display name.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.bottom.enabled: Whether the bottom-side layer is enabled.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.bottom.kind: Bottom-side mechanical layer kind enum name; see valid kind names in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.layer_1: Legacy flat pair form: first mechanical layer in the pair.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.layer_2: Legacy flat pair form: second mechanical layer in the pair.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_pairs.pair_index: Legacy flat pair form: optional pair ordering override.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_kinds: Editable mechanical layer kind assignment rows.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_kinds.layer: Mechanical layer id to assign; see valid ids in the header.
jsonc-comments.mechanical_layer_kinds.kind: Mechanical layer kind enum name; see valid kind names in the header.
